backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods or state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing implemented features, affected files, components, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of key frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH-based theme tokens, dark mode variables, and base layout styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with manifest and icon links.
frontend/public/site.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, colors, and launch configuration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling all screen navigation and app state such as selected feeling and location.
frontend/src/components/GrownUpsGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder containing no implementation.
frontend/src/components/ScreenLayout.tsx: Generic page layout component with logo header, optional title, scroll control, and helper/disclaimer sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hook managing Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and login status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, custom color variables, dark mode tokens, base styles, and custom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app using React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdultMessagePage.tsx: Shows an alert message with chime/vibration feedback and a delayed encouragement message.
frontend/src/pages/DailyFeelingsTrackerP: Lets users log daily feelings and displays recent entries with simple history formatting.
frontend/src/pages/EnergyCheckPage.tsx: Allows selecting current energy level and shows a visual indicator that changes with selection.
frontend/src/pages/FeelBetterPage.tsx: Provides calming breathing animation and simple supportive suggestions.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingConfirmationPa: Confirms a selected feeling and prompts the user to show it to an adult.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingsButtonPage.ts: Displays a grid of body-feeling options that users can tap to select.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/AboutPage.ts: Provides an about section with background information on the app and its purpose, including credits and back navigation.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/ForParentsTe: Explains the app to parents and teachers, outlining usage tips and important guidance through multiple info cards.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsArea: Offers grown-ups settings including sound toggle, tracker reset, and links to information pages, with preference state management.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsLock: Implements a two-step grown-ups lock using a press-and-hold action followed by a simple math question before granting access.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafet: Details the app’s privacy and safety principles, emphasizing offline use, no data collection, and general safety guidance.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/TeacherQuick: Renders a teacher quick guide screen with back navigation and several info cards for classroom use, steps, privacy, and reminders.
frontend/src/pages/LocationPage.tsx: Asks the user where they are and provides simple location selection buttons.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Renders the main menu with navigation buttons to feelings, energy check, tracker, feel-better, and grown-ups lock screens. Uses ScreenLayout and themed UI components.
frontend/src/pages/SplashScreen.tsx: Displays a fading splash screen logo and transitions automatically to the next screen after a timed sequence.
frontend/src/pages/WelcomePage.tsx: Shows a welcome message with the Luma character and a single Start button to begin the app flow.
frontend/src/state/preferences.ts: Manages user preferences in localStorage, supporting loading defaults and updating sound settings.
frontend/src/state/tracker.ts: Handles tracking of recent feeling entries in localStorage, allowing retrieval, addition, and reset of tracker data.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with extended colors, animations, plugins, and app-specific theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, requirements, features, and architectural notes for the My Health Buddy app.
